title: New neighborhoods in the edge woods
summary: Rezones wooded parcels near the edge of the map for single-family subdivisions.

how: Planning staff review the rezoning and subdivision applications.
OWASA reviews whether water and sewer lines can be extended to the parcels.
The Planning Commission reviews the proposal and makes a recommendation.
Residents comment at a Town Council public hearing.
Town Council votes on the rezoning.

pros: At 60 acres, adds about 240 single-family homes.
cons: At 60 acres, removes about 36 acres of tree canopy.
New homes at the map edge add to the average commute.
Needs new roads and water and sewer lines to reach the parcels.
